story: A girl who gets gifts from birds
text: bullshit. Perhaps you don't understand that crows use tools. [VIDEO] and that they also are social and communicate with each other. They do give gifts to each other as part of courtship. We don't need to anthropomorphize to recognize plain facts about crows being intelligent and intentional and social.
